lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: It's eleven fifty-six a.m., on November seventeenth, twenty one hundred.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: How long have we been flying over Earth?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: We have flown a total of three thousand, seven hundred and ten days... nine hours, and seventeen minutes.
lines.display: We have flown a total of 3,710 days, 9 hours and 17 minutes.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: We have twelve gallons left. Enough to fly for about five hours.
lines.display: We have 12 gallons left. Enough to fly for about 5 hours.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Save our journals and photos to the hard drive, please.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Log entry. Five years of Earth reconnaissance after return. Possible loss of auxiliary probe power unit. Very little land to land on... mostly submerged. No one found. Unfeeling freedom.
lines.display:
Five years of Earth reconnaissance after return.
Possible loss of auxiliary probe power unit.
Very little land to land on, mostly submerged.
No one found. Unfeeling freedom.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: If you're done... let's fly at full speed.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: Where should I set our destination?

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: No. Do you think a destination is useful?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.text: All we have left is a barrel of emergency fuel.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Let's just go. Until it's all worn out.
